title: I Just Found the Perfect Business for you to Start (yes, you)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
description:
8/3/25 UPDATE! I just flew to Utah and spent a half a day with Kyler delivering appliances and picking his brain in person! Watch the follow up video here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UCdWRg1KQLY&list=PL5doEXwy4gHUcLKMc_MMzO-cNTW4ZSAat

Also, he now has a stupid cheap course for anyone serious about doing this. He’ll help you 1 on 1. Link here: http://Applianceskool.com

My friend Kyler turned 1 Facebook Marketplace post into an appliance rental business that generates near-passive income requiring only 5-10 hours of work per week. We talk IN DETAIL about how he started his appliance rental company, scaling, and leveraging Facebook Marketplace to validate ideas. Go copy Kyler in your home market already!! Enjoy!

Get my 12 favorite biz ideas for 2024, with full launch plans included here: https://tkopod.co/youtubeD

Timestamps below. Enjoy!
